hooks.name: session-start
hooks.description: Load profile and tech stack context at the start of each Claude Code session

hooks.name: session-end
hooks.description: Write session summary to audit log at the end of each session

hooks.name: audit-trail
hooks.description: Write all significant events to the JSONL audit log

hooks.name: secret-scanner
hooks.description: Scan all file writes for hardcoded secrets and credentials

hooks.name: governance-gate
hooks.description: Enforce governance checks before merge operations

hooks.name: codebase-context
hooks.description: Inject codebase knowledge (patterns, architecture, guidelines) at session start
hooks.note: Runs after session-start. Provides learned project context to all agents.

hooks.name: knowledge-sync
hooks.description: Auto-detect knowledge refresh needs at session end and prompt if needed

hooks.name: spec-validator
hooks.description: Validate spec compliance before git commits on spec feature branches
hooks.note: Set RAPIDX_STRICT_SPEC=1 to block commits on spec violations
